A government subsidies committee sets prices every quarter. We found no published decision for Q4 2026 (October–December), so the Ultra 98 figure is the latest announced. Kuwait has no VAT.

How to work out your fuel cost

Full tank = tank size × price a litre. Monthly cost = (distance a month × litres per 100 km ÷ 100) × price. A car covering 2,000 km a month at 8 litres per 100 km needs 160 litres: KD 13.600 with Premium 91, or KD 163.200 a year.

To compare all six GCC states in AED, see GCC petrol prices.

Frequently asked questions

What are petrol prices in Kuwait in 2026?

Premium 91 is 85 fils a litre and Super 95 is 105 fils, both fixed since September 2016. Ultra 98 was 275 fils in Q3 2026, and diesel and kerosene are 115 fils.

How often do Kuwait fuel prices change?

A government subsidies committee reviews them every quarter; in practice only Ultra 98 moves while Premium, Super and diesel stay fixed.

How much does a 60-litre tank cost in Kuwait?

KD 5.100 with Premium 91, KD 6.300 with Super 95, KD 16.500 with Ultra 98 and KD 6.900 with diesel.

Is petrol in Kuwait cheaper than elsewhere in the GCC?

Yes: a litre of 95 costs about AED 1.25 versus 2.12 in Qatar, 2.28 in Saudi Arabia and Oman and 4.04 in the UAE (November 2026).
